'''Frizz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Defel/Legends|Defel]].

==Biography==
Frizz was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]] and after leaving his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], he was befriended by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] criminal [[Kal Jorek]]. Jorek could not pronounce Frizz's Defel name correctly, so gave him the new name "Frizz," which the Defel eventually became accustomed to. Frizz became Jorek's right-hand man and once, while working for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], they traveled to the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where they sold illegal weaponry from a warehouse on the edge of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. While they were there, the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Trayl Caltos]] hired some [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to stake out the warehouse and capture Jorek and Frizz.
